answer: Before the stamp comes 25 stamped dockets, each costing £14 to have checked, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The counter asks for Coverbound leaf gilder press charter first, and a charter leaf gilders present after paper mill inspections is the answer it accepts. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. One vertex, one entry. The clerk notes pearl. Every violet is counted once.
